description_en: Farka Hills is a unique residence in Tirana, conceived to offer more than a house — a lifestyle in harmony with nature. Conceived as a park for living, the residence offers tranquility, fluidity and harmony, with evergreens and architecture that "breathes" with the landscape. In this complex we have for sale Apartment 1+1 Information about the apartment: • Apartment area (net): 63.8m2 • Apartment area (gross): 72.31 m2 • Veranda area: 3.63 m2 • Floor 1 Organization: • Living room • Kitchen room • Bedroom • Toilets Other settings: • Pit phase • High quality of construction A place where comfort and everything you need is always nearby. Farka Hills is an address that unites nature with the city, just 10 minutes from the center of Tirana, lying on the hills of Farka with a direct view of the lake. • Direct access to the Farka Lake Promenade • Immediate exit to the Great Ring Road • 10 minutes from the TEG shopping center • 30,000 m² of construction integrated in well-maintained green spaces For a visit to the property contact us!
